title: Table Compression
statementMd:
Little Petya is now fond of data compression algorithms. He has already studied *gz*, *bz*, *zip* algorithms and many others. Inspired by the new knowledge, Petya is now developing the new compression algorithm which he wants to name *dis*.

Petya decided to compress tables. He is given a table $*a*$ consisting of $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns that is filled with positive integers. He wants to build the table $*a*'$ consisting of positive integers such that the relative order of the elements in each row and each column remains the same. That is, if in some row $*i*$ of the initial table $*a*_{*i*, *j*} < *a*_{*i*, *k*}$, then in the resulting table $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} < *a*'_{*i*, *k*}$, and if $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*i*, *k*}$ then $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} = *a*'_{*i*, *k*}$. Similarly, if in some column $*j*$ of the initial table $*a*_{*i*, *j*} < *a*_{*p*, *j*}$ then in compressed table $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} < *a*'_{*p*, *j*}$ and if $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*p*, *j*}$ then $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} = *a*'_{*p*, *j*}$.

Because large values require more space to store them, the maximum value in $*a*'$ should be as small as possible.

Petya is good in theory, however, he needs your help to implement the algorithm.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ce9eb3b66e2ccbb79eae736994b3703b3b8e7d2.png), the number of rows and the number of columns of the table respectively.

Each of the following $*n*$ rows contain $*m*$ integers $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*, *j*} ≤ 10^{9})$ that are the values in the table.

## Output

Output the compressed table in form of $*n*$ lines each containing $*m*$ integers.

If there exist several answers such that the maximum number in the compressed table is minimum possible, you are allowed to output any of them.

## Note

In the first sample test, despite the fact $*a*_{1, 2} ≠ *a*_{21}$, they are not located in the same row or column so they may become equal after the compression.
statementZhMd:
小佩佳现在喜欢上了数据压缩算法。他已经学习过 *gz*、*bz*、*zip* 算法以及许多其他算法。受到新知识的启发，小佩佳正在开发一种新的压缩算法，并希望将其命名为 *dis*。

小佩佳决定压缩表格。给定一个由 $*n*$ 行和 $*m*$ 列组成、且填有正整数的表格 $*a*$。他希望构造一个由正整数组成的表格 $*a*'$，使得每一行和每一列中元素的相对顺序保持不变。也就是说，如果初始表格 $*a*$ 的某一行 $*i*$ 中满足 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} < *a*_{*i*, *k*}$，那么在结果表格中应满足 $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} < *a*'_{*i*, *k*}$；如果 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*i*, *k*}$，那么应满足 $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} = *a*'_{*i*, *k*}$。类似地，如果初始表格的某一列 $*j*$ 中满足 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} < *a*_{*p*, *j*}$，那么在压缩后的表格中应满足 $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} < *a*'_{*p*, *j*}$；如果 $*a*_{*i*, *j*} = *a*_{*p*, *j*}$，那么应满足 $*a*'_{*i*, *j*} = *a*'_{*p*, *j*}$。

由于较大的数需要更多空间来存储，因此应使 $*a*'$ 中的最大值尽可能小。

小佩佳理论知识丰富，但他需要你的帮助来实现这个算法。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8ce9eb3b66e2ccbb79eae736994b3703b3b8e7d2.png)，分别表示表格的行数和列数）。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*, *j*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*, *j*} ≤ 10^{9})$，表示表格中的元素。

## 输出格式

以 $*n*$ 行的形式输出压缩后的表格，每行包含 $*m*$ 个整数。

如果存在多个答案，且它们的压缩表格中的最大值均已达到可能的最小值，则可以输出其中任意一个。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，尽管 $*a*_{1, 2} ≠ *a*_{21}$，但它们不在同一行或同一列中，因此经过压缩后可以变得相等。
